CREATE TABLE queue_messages (
    id INTEGER NOT NULL AUTO_INCREMENT, 
    queue_id INTEGER NOT NULL COMMENT 'Work queue ID (kinds.id)', 
    sender_user_id INTEGER NOT NULL COMMENT 'Sender user ID', 
    recipient_user_id INTEGER NOT NULL COMMENT 'Recipient user ID (queue owner)', 
    source_task_id INTEGER NOT NULL COMMENT 'Original task/conversation ID', 
    source_subtask_ids JSON NOT NULL COMMENT 'List of original message IDs (subtask IDs)', 
    content_snapshot JSON NOT NULL COMMENT 'Snapshot of message content including text and attachments', 
    note TEXT NOT NULL COMMENT 'Sender''s note/comment', 
    priority ENUM('low','normal','high') NOT NULL, 
    status ENUM('unread','read','processing','processed','archived') NOT NULL, 
    process_result JSON NOT NULL COMMENT 'AI processing result', 
    process_task_id INTEGER NOT NULL COMMENT 'Task ID created for processing (0 = not processed)' DEFAULT '0', 
    created_at DATETIME NOT NULL DEFAULT now(), 
    updated_at DATETIME NOT NULL DEFAULT now(), 
    processed_at DATETIME NOT NULL COMMENT 'Processing completion time' DEFAULT now(), 
    PRIMARY KEY (id)
)
CREATE INDEX ix_queue_messages_queue_status ON queue_messages (queue_id, status)
CREATE INDEX ix_queue_messages_recipient_status ON queue_messages (recipient_user_id, status)

when.query: SELECT COUNT(*) AS n FROM information_schema.TABLES WHERE TABLE_SCHEMA=DATABASE() AND TABLE_NAME='queue_messages'

CREATE TABLE recent_contacts (
    id INTEGER NOT NULL AUTO_INCREMENT, 
    user_id INTEGER NOT NULL COMMENT 'User ID', 
    contact_user_id INTEGER NOT NULL COMMENT 'Contact user ID', 
    last_contact_at DATETIME NOT NULL COMMENT 'Last contact time' DEFAULT now(), 
    contact_count INTEGER NOT NULL COMMENT 'Contact count', 
    PRIMARY KEY (id)
)
CREATE INDEX ix_recent_contacts_user_contact ON recent_contacts (user_id, contact_user_id)
